# SelfOrganizing_Architecture

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network topology that autonomously adjusts its connectivity and unit parameters based on local data and resource constraints, without external supervision. Enables in-network adaptation for edge AI, reducing reliance on cloud retraining and improving resilience in dynamic environments.
